title: AGENT TASK: still frames only. Photoreal live-ac…

messages.content:
AGENT TASK: still frames only. Photoreal live-action. Two adult women from my reference sheets.
No captions on the images. No extra people in the foreground.

ATTACH
Image A = Bulma sheet. Keep her face, aqua-blue high ponytail, red ribbon.
Image B = Android 18 sheet. Keep her face, short blonde bob, bangs, blue eyes.

LOOK
Yard: orange swimwear on Bulma, black swimwear on 18, lounge chairs, umbrellas, drinks.
Driveway and car: light beach cover-ups over the same swimwear, flip-flops.
Background yard only: two distant men sparring in the sky, small in frame, orange gi and blue armor.

RULES
Same faces every frame.
Photoreal, not cartoon.
If a face changes, redo that frame.

MAKE START + LAST FOR EACH BEAT

PRE01
START: wide yard, both on lounge chairs under umbrellas, watching the sky.
LAST: Bulma talking, looking up; 18 listening.
Line: Bulma says she does not get closeness from Vegeta and feels lonely.

PRE02
START: two-shot, Bulma turned toward 18, still talking.
LAST: Bulma looking down. 18 watching her.
Same line continues.

PRE03
START: 18 leans in, kind face.
LAST: closeup on 18, private thoughtful look.
Line: “Bulma, I’m here for you.”
Thought, 18: maybe now is the time to make my move.

PRE04
START: Bulma looks away, cheeks pink, mid-sentence.
LAST: closeup Bulma looking away.
Line: “oh... I mean yeah.... but not....”
Thought, Bulma: oh... does she mean?

PRE05
START: 18 looks down, unsure.
LAST: 18 looks back up.
Thought, 18: should I push?
Line: “I know what you mean.”

PRE06
START: 18 looking at Bulma, curious.
LAST: Bulma surprised, then pleased and curious.
Line: “but maybe?...”

PRE07
START: Bulma brighter, sitting forward.
LAST: 18 answers fast, eager.
Line, Bulma: “maybe we should get out of here, right?”
Line, 18: “yeah absolutely, lets ditch these losers.”
Thought, 18: oh my god, is this really happening?

PRE08
START: they stand and walk away from the chairs in swimwear. Sky spar still behind them.
LAST: they reach a car in the driveway.

PRE09
START: cover-ups on, loading bags into the car.
LAST: 18 has been looking at Bulma’s cover-up neckline and just got caught. 18 looks away.
Line, Bulma: “so where should we go?”

PRE10
START: still at the car, talking.
LAST: Bulma blushing after 18’s answer.
Line, 18: “I don’t care, I’m just having fun being with you.”
Thought, Bulma: wow, maybe this could be leading to something. I guess I may as well.

PRE11
START: Bulma speaking up, excited.
LAST: 18 eyebrows up, small smirk.
Line, Bulma: “lets go to my place!”
Line, 18: “sure, that sounds good.”

PRE12
START: car interior, Bulma driving, 18 passenger. Bulma glances toward 18, then back to the road.
LAST: the glance lasts longer, then she faces the road again.

PRE13
START: Bulma’s eyes stay off the road too long.
LAST: 18 alert. Another car is close ahead in the other lane.
Line, 18: “Watch out!”

PRE14
START: Bulma turns the wheel back into her lane.
LAST: road clear. Bulma sorry. 18 looking out the window.
Thought, Bulma: Oh my god that was close.
Line, Bulma: “oh my god, i’m so sorry 18.”
Line, 18: “it’s ok.”

PRE14B
START: Bulma still driving, embarrassed joke.
LAST: 18 scoffs and looks out the window.
Line, Bulma: “ok… if it’s any constellation I think I peed myself.”

PRE14C
START: Bulma checks the front of her swimwear under the cover-up after the scare, quick embarrassed look.
LAST: closeup Bulma driving, face very pink, eyes on the road.
Thought, Bulma: oh goodness…. that’s not my pee, that’s my.

OUTPUT
pre01_start.png pre01_last.png
through
pre14_last.png pre14b.png pre14c.png

One short visual prompt under each file. No text painted on the pictures. Stop after stills.
